repo.description: Independent upstream F-Droid repository for ROS Pocket. Not the official f-droid.org catalogue. Direct DDS ROS 2 inspector, read-only. APKs signed by the ROS Pocket upstream production key.

apps.description:
ROS Pocket is a read-only Android inspector using direct DDS and Cyclone DDS.
Inspect discovered topics, supported telemetry types and sensor views, monitor
numeric histories and export CSV, and manage portable local bench profiles.
Native workspace with Dashboard, Explore, Graph and Logs, system/light/dark
themes, circular namespace groups and local visual physics. Namespace does
not identify a ROS package; arrows are announced associations, not traffic.

ARM64 devices, Android 9 (API 28) or later. Network discovery depends on your
ROS domain, peers and network setup, with explicit LAN or routed VPN mode.
RF/IP recovery and actual VPN absence/return remain unqualified. The final
version1.3 APK was host-validated, without new physical-device acceptance.

This is the independent upstream repository, not the official f-droid.org
catalogue. APKs keep the upstream production signature used by GitHub releases.
apps.summary: Read-only ROS 2 and DDS inspection on Android

en-US.description:
ROS Pocket is a read-only ROS 2/DDS inspector for Android phones and tablets.

Connect using explicit LAN/Wi-Fi or routed VPN mode, select the ROS domain and manual Humble or Jazzy graph format, then inspect topic types, publishers, subscribers, endpoint QoS and announced ROS nodes.

• Native Dashboard, Explore, Graph and Logs workspace with system/light/dark themes.
• Four watches with counters, received rate and data age; explicit slot choice and replacement confirmation.
• Split Explorer on tablets, local search/filters/favorites and topic metadata.
• Circular node/topic graph with namespace groups, local visual physics, drag/pan/zoom, pins and inspector.
• Numeric plots with pause and CSV export of retained samples.
• Compact rosout console with selected-event inspector.
• One bounded LaserScan or Image/CompressedImage visual reader, separate from the four watches.
• Saved connection/watch/plot/sensor profiles with JSON import/export.

DDS/Cyclone/JNI remain native. No rosbridge or cloud account is required; no ads or analytics. No robot commands, parameter writes, services or teleoperation. Only actual readers are announced in existing ROS discovery metadata.

Limitations: ARM64, Android 9+, IPv4 and a defined set of standard message types. VPN mode requires an explicit accessible IPv4 peer and app access to the VPN. Graph format is manual; all ROS/RMW/network/device combinations are not guaranteed. Namespace is not package discovery; graph distances/forces are visual only and arrows do not prove traffic or QoS compatibility. Actual VPN absence/return and physical Wi-Fi/IP recovery remain unqualified. Final1.3 APK host-validated without new physical acceptance. Bounded retention is not lossless recording or rosbag.

Independent upstream F-Droid repository, not the official catalogue. Production installs separately from DEV. Bench engineering tool, not a safety instrument.

pt-BR.description:
ROS Pocket é um inspetor ROS 2/DDS somente leitura para celulares e tablets Android.

Escolha LAN/Wi-Fi ou VPN roteada, domínio ROS e formato manual Humble ou Jazzy. Inspecione tópicos, tipos, publicadores/assinantes, endpoints, QoS e nós anunciados.

• Interface nativa com Painel, Explorar, Grafo e Logs; temas Sistema/Claro/Escuro.
• Quatro watches com contadores, taxa recebida e idade; escolha explícita de slot e confirmação antes de substituir.
• Explorer dividido no tablet, busca, filtros, favoritos e metadados de tópicos.
• Grafo circular de nós/tópicos por namespace, física visual local, arraste/pan/zoom, pins e inspetor.
• Gráficos numéricos com pausa e CSV das amostras retidas.
• Console rosout compacto com inspetor da amostra selecionada.
• Um leitor visual limitado de LaserScan ou Image/CompressedImage, separado dos quatro watches.
• Perfis locais de conexão/watches/gráficos/sensores com transporte JSON.

DDS/Cyclone/JNI nativos, sem rosbridge, conta na nuvem, anúncios ou analytics. Sem comandos ao robô, escrita de parâmetros, serviços ou teleop. Somente os leitores reais são anunciados nos metadados de descoberta ROS existentes.

Limites: ARM64, Android9+, IPv4 e tipos padrão definidos. VPN exige peer IPv4 acessível e acesso do app à VPN. Formato do grafo é manual; não há garantia de todas as combinações ROS/RMW/rede/dispositivo. Namespace não é descoberta de pacotes; forças/distâncias são apenas visuais e setas não comprovam tráfego ou QoS. Ausência/retorno real da VPN e recuperação física de Wi-Fi/IP continuam não qualificadas. APK final1.3 validado no host, sem novo aceite físico. Retenção limitada, não gravação sem perdas nem rosbag.

Repositório F-Droid upstream independente, não o catálogo oficial. Produção instala ao lado do DEV. Ferramenta de bancada, não instrumento de segurança.
